comment: Tam-Tara Deepcroft trash (BNpcBase 1346): 980 HP, level 16; auto-attack 871 every 3.0 s, 722 every 8.6 s. From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Tam-Tara Deepcroft (2026-10-24): one run with Duty Support (3ec702a8, visit 0.3) and two Duty Finder runs (cc26e0ea, visits 0.2 and 0.4), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
